## Patterson-UTI Energy Announces Third Quarter Earnings Conference Call and Webcast


10/07/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 85 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/927518908/files/doc_news/Patterson-UTI-Energy-Announces-Third-Quarter-Earnings-Conference-Call-and-Webcast-2026.pdf)


**HOUSTON, TX /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / October 7, 2026 /** **PATTERSON-UTI ENERGY, INC.** (NASDAQ:PTEN) will host a conference call on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Central Time to discuss results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


Participants can access the call by dialing (833) 461-5787 in North America or (585) 542-9983 if International and referencing Meeting ID 653 922 397. The call will also be webcast and can be accessed through a link in the Investors section of the Company's website at[investor.patenergy.com](https://pr.report/s5kx) . A webcast replay of the conference call will be available on the Company's website for one year.


**About Patterson-UTI**


Patterson-UTI is a leading provider of drilling and completion services to oil and natural gas exploration and production companies in the United States and other select countries, including contract drilling services, integrated well completion services and directional drilling services in the United States, and specialized bit solutions in the United States, Middle East and many other regions around the world. For more information, visit[www.patenergy.com](https://pr.report/s5ky) .
